correctness.rationale: The claimed homotopy type is correct. An independent graph construction verifies Desargues has n=20, cubic degrees and girth six. Therefore every connected three-set is exactly one induced two-edge path (3n=60 total), and the published triangle/C4-free ordinary cut-complex theorem applies. Its proof uses unique nonedge endpoint pairs to collapse Alexander dual to a graph, integral duality and Hurewicz–Whitehead; the exact sphere count is C(19,2)-3*20=111, in degree n-4=16. This reconstructs the proof without trusting the source one-million-face matching/log. Domain exactly the defined finite graph.
